sources.title: Granite 4.1 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: About Granite 4.1 Granite 4.1 is a family of dense language models offered in 3B, 8B, and 30B parameter sizes. Each model is available in both base and instruction-tuned variants. Compared to Granite 4.0, Granite 4.1 delivers major improvements in tool use, instruction following, coding performance, and mathematical reasoning.
